up: Retrieve exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614108. Join the assays table on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614108' to the activities table. Filter activities to only include exact values where standard_relation = '='. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno to get the molecule ChEMBL ID, and join compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Return the following columns: canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614108' AND a.standard_relation = '='
